decisions.reason: As a comparatively small add-on with only brief launch visibility and no continuing website presence, this plugin carries too little strategic centrality or public commitment for us to keep escalating resources into it by 2022.

This GIS solution platform is strategically central to our announced direction, likely required substantial development effort, and received increased standalone positioning, so management would persist with it despite any mixed signals.

Mobile field data capture fits our core geospatial integration and mobile offering, remained visibly marketed across years, and any slower uptake can plausibly be treated as a temporary customer adoption or procurement issue.
The search extension is close to our established web map business and was still being versioned and promoted after launch, which supports continued commitment and justification of prior investment.
